title: Order at a café or bakery
objective: Order politely, ask the price and understand the answer.
explanation: The polite all-purpose way to order is “Jeg vil gerne have …” (I would like …): “Jeg vil gerne have en kop kaffe.” To ask the price: “Hvad koster det?” The answer sounds like “Det koster 35 kroner.” End with “Tak” — Danish has no special word for “please”, the politeness is in “gerne” and in thanking.
sourceReference: Deepwater original starter course (2026-10-29), written for Echo; teacher review required before publishing.

exercises.prompt: Which is the polite way to order?
exercises.feedbackCorrect: Right: “Jeg vil gerne have …” is polite and natural.

options.text: Jeg vil gerne have en kaffe.

exercises.feedbackCorrect: Correct: “Jeg vil gerne have et rundstykke.”

exercises.prompt: Write the three lines you would say at a bakery: order two things, ask the price, and say thank you.
